name: Youjin Jang
title: Associate Professor; Principal Investigator, S2MART Construction Lab
fitReason: Strong applied robotics-AI fit through learned human-state assessment and PPO control, within a broader construction-safety research program.

physicalEvidence.summary: The same September 2026 Go2 study uses physiological trust and visual distraction estimates to select PPO motion policies. Its eight-person results are descriptive, with residual close/high-speed motion and no ablation isolating human-state effects from proximity. Jang’s current lab independently reports lead author Hardik Chauhan’s July 2026 dissertation defense on this adaptive robot framework, establishing directed-group linkage. Limited workshop detail and controlled scale justify 23 rather than maximum hardware credit.

name: Christopher Kitts
title: William and Janice Terry Professor; Director, Robotic Systems Laboratory; Associate Dean
fitReason: Practical robotics with an executed neural-perception interface for manipulation; core program also includes substantial classical systems/control.

physicalEvidence.summary: The complete author-hosted ASME IMECE2024 manuscript, carrying2025 publication copyright, executes MediaPipe hand recognition and learned ZED2i skeleton detection through Jetson/ROS to command a physical four-DOF DexArm suction-cup pick-and-place. Point gestures specify goals; fists trigger pick/place. Motion planning remains conventional. UR5/Yaskawa are interface examples, not demonstrated platforms in this experiment. It is an early prototype without a quantitative user study; future voice integration, grasp-orientation and force selection are not credited. The current RSL page independently confirms human-cobot projects, a manipulator workcell and embedded MegaChips collaborators, linking the paper’s industry/university team to Kitts’s directed lab.

shortVisit.summary: RSL currently seeks students for capstone/thesis and directed projects and hosts embedded MegaChips visiting scholars. Neither statement establishes a general external-master eight-week invitation, so visitor score remains 0.

scoreReasons.fit: Executed learned perception-to-manipulation interface; broader lab is mixed AI/classical field robotics.
scoreReasons.physical: Real current-lab prototype with independent group linkage; limited experimental depth.
scoreReasons.shortVisit: Degree/project recruitment and corporate visitor precedent do not establish an external-master offer.
